content.title: Dhurandhar 2 OTT Release Date
content.text: Article by Nishant Published on: 12:44 am, 12 March 2026 Dhurandhar 2 is taking the Box Office by a storm. While the first part, Dhurandhar, is currently streaming on Netflix, the OTT rights for the sequel have been secured by Jio Hotstar. The film is expected to arrive on the streaming platform only after completing its eight-week theatrical run. So, Dhurandhar 2 has to arrive on Jio Hotstar on May 14, 2026.
